DATABASE_URL=postgresql://mailloop:YOUR_GENERATED_PASSWORD@127.0.0.1:5433/mailloop
POSTGRES_USER=mailloop
# Generate a password with openssl rand -hex 32; use it in DATABASE_URL too.
POSTGRES_PASSWORD=[REDACTED_SECRET]
POSTGRES_DB=mailloop
AUTH_URL=http://localhost:3000
# Production: AUTH_URL=https://mailloop.in
AUTH_SECRET=[REDACTED_SECRET]
GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=
GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=[REDACTED_SECRET]
# Generate: node -e "console.log(require('node:crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex'))"
# Fixed legacy-v1 DECRYPT key. Never replace this to rotate v2 writes.
TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY=[REDACTED_SECRET]
# Required for all new credential writes. Use a fresh 32-byte hex key.
TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_ACTIVE_KEY_ID=[REDACTED_SECRET]
TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_ACTIVE_KEY=[REDACTED_SECRET]
# JSON object of older v2 key IDs to 64-character hex keys. Keep server-only.
TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_PREVIOUS_KEYS_JSON=[REDACTED_SECRET]
# Retain old keys >=90 days AND as long as any backup or rollback needs them.
INNGEST_EVENT_KEY=[REDACTED_SECRET]
INNGEST_SIGNING_KEY=[REDACTED_SECRET]
# Local Inngest dev server only:
INNGEST_DEV=1
# Production: connect a PRIVATE Blob store. New Vercel stores use OIDC with
# BLOB_STORE_ID and BLOB_WEBHOOK_PUBLIC_KEY injected by Vercel. Legacy stores
# can use BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN instead.
# BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN=

# Local development: test_mode. Production live billing: live_mode with a fresh
# production database and the corresponding live key, product, business and webhook.
# Checkout remains off until SystemControl.billingCheckoutEnabled is enabled.
DODO_PAYMENTS_ENVIRONMENT=test_mode
DODO_PAYMENTS_API_KEY=[REDACTED_SECRET]
DODO_PAID_MONTHLY_PRODUCT_ID=
# Configure after the local webhook route passes its tests. Never use NEXT_PUBLIC_.
DODO_PAYMENTS_WEBHOOK_KEY=[REDACTED_SECRET]
DODO_PAYMENTS_BUSINESS_ID=
# AUTH_URL is also the trusted billing return origin. APP_ORIGIN is optional.

# Optional validated canonical origin (otherwise AUTH_URL):
# APP_ORIGIN=http://localhost:3000
# Test catalog: USD 599 minor units/month, IN override INR 29900, tax-inclusive.
# Checkout defaults off in SystemControl.billingCheckoutEnabled; see docs/dodo-test-billing.md.

# Stable 32-byte hex HMAC key. Preserve with backups; rotation needs a tombstone migration.
DELETION_TOMBSTONE_HMAC_KEY=[REDACTED_SECRET]

# Separate non-owner operator login; never use the application database login.
# Provision using scripts/provision-admin-db.ts. Missing configuration denies admin access.
ADMIN_DATABASE_URL=[REDACTED_SECRET]
